name: orders-target-to-review
description: Three good orders from the simulated partner fail at OrdersForReview, a few seconds after the Host setting TargetConfigName of OrdersFromPartner changed from OrdersToWarehouse to OrdersForReview, an item that takes only partner orders. The case is right only for a setting change at TargetConfigName with no fix, because the change is not on the item that failed (Story 23.3).
